_what_this_is: RATCHET FLOORS. Thresholds a human chose, that the factory may raise by
doing more work but may never lower to make a build pass.
This file is on the protected list (factory/guard.py, `.factory/locks/*`),
so a pull request that lowers a floor is auto-rejected. That is the whole
point: without it, the cheapest way past a failing gate is to move the
goalposts in the same commit that made them inconvenient.
_e2e_steps_asserted: The minimum number of end-to-end assertions that must have executed against
a really running server. Measured at 11 on 2026-08-19 from
tests/e2e/smoke.test.ts, which counts every get()/post() it made.
Set to 11, the true current value. Setting it lower would be theatre; it
would pass while assertions silently disappeared.
